test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states has implemented a programme for tree plantation under the name 'Haritha Haram’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Telangana.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Telangana launched the 6th phase of the Haritha Haram programme in June 2020 targeting to plant about 30 crore saplings across the state.
 
• The programme was launched on 3rd July 2015 by Chief Minister K Chandrashekar Rao.
 
• The Telangana state government has set a target to increase the forest cover in the state to 33 per cent from 24 per cent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In 2020, the Chief Minister of Telangana K Chandrashekhar Rao has launched the sixth phase of the Haritha Haram Programme.
 
• In the sixth phase, Target is to plant 30 crore saplings across the state.
 
• Dual-purpose of environment and employment under the National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (NREGS).
